snippet.title: TEKKEN 7 - Eliza DLC Character Reveal Trailer | PS4, XB1, PC
snippet.description:
Eliza thirsts for the blood of her opponents! Pre-order TEKKEN 7 on any platform to receive Eliza on June 2nd, 2017!

Pre-order TEKKEN 7 now @ http://tk7.tekken.com/preorder-now
